description: This Java class defines the LoginCredential entity used in the OpenMRS platform, responsible for storing user password data, secrets, and change metadata. It supports password verification and includes fields like userId, hashedPassword, salt, secret questions, and activation keys.

classes.name: LoginCredential
classes.description: A data model class representing user login credentials, including password hash, salt, security questions, change tracking, and activation key.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Verifies if the provided plaintext password matches the stored hashed password using security hashing utilities.
